did: Built Run it again on the phone's Studio > Renders: an essay that burnt or that home refused opens a page saying what happened, which scene or take by name, whether home tries again by itself or holds it, and what you can do. When takes home couldn't hear stop it, the step opens Needs your attention showing only those takes, and the button turns on once each is being heard again; after the tap the conveyor follows it from asked to made. The recorder now names each scene too full for its frame, so a refusal never shows an id. The last piece adds home's test for a take still unheard to the promise the page keeps (CW9).

calls.title: Only asking home to hear a take again unblocks a refused essay; recording it again doesn't
options: hear again unblocks, record again doesn't, never on a guess
any act that takes a take off the list unblocks it, as the owner's words say ("retry them again or speak them again")
no gate on the phone: the button is always on and home refuses
calls.why: A cards essay plays the very take ids its cut list names, so home lets it through only once those takes are heard; a new recording doesn't replace one in the essay.
calls.undo: Change attentionOf and the takes words in apps/www/src/lib/renders/again; a story where a re-recorded take stands in for the old one on home would make record again count too (C1221).

calls.title: Run it again is one family over every row that couldn't finish
options: one Stop union over every row, its steps by exhaustive switch
a Retry button per essay kind (cards, Rust Rounds, interview), each with its own reasons
a button on every failed row that always asks home, letting home refuse
calls.why: The owner named two cases of one family; a compile-time union makes each new kind of stop a case the compiler checks, and a stop the phone can't change shows what will change it instead of a dead button.
calls.undo: Drop lib/renders/again, components/studio/run-again.tsx, the renders/$feed/$key route and the row's way in on Renders (C1220).

calls.title: The takes to answer open on Needs your attention itself, filtered
options: filter the existing page by the takes' ids
list and act on the takes on the Run it again page
link to the whole page unfiltered
calls.why: The owner asked to be cycled to the subset; filtering the page that already hears takes again keeps one place that does it.
calls.undo: Drop only from TakeReconcile and the route's validateSearch, and link to the whole page (C1223).

calls.title: The recorder names each overflowing scene on its own line after the ids
options: names after the ids, one line each, from the chapter and place the recorder already holds
name on the same line as its id
home derives names from the ids and the essay it holds
calls.why: Only the recorder knows each scene's human name, and keeping the ids first leaves home's worker reading them as before; agreed with REDO-S.
calls.undo: Return overflowLines to ids only and drop sceneNames and Shot.name; home's board then counts the scenes (C1224).

left: #3468 (CW9 gains home's take-unheard 409 test) is open and unarmed for the coordinator to merge; it waited on server#1143 reaching server main (AL1).
